capabilities: Arrange media and embeds in side-by-side rows
Resize columns, rows and whole blocks by dragging
Wrap text around floated media and text boxes
Add captions and figure, table and equation cross-references
Keep layouts as plain Markdown inside HTML comments
extras: No telemetry; remote media and web embeds load directly from their source URLs. Reading View is read-only, so layouts are edited in Live Preview. A Feature examples command provides offline sample notes.
problem: Obsidian embeds media one per line, so placing images side by side or wrapping text around them means hand-writing HTML that breaks on rename.

relations.evidence: local Excalidraw drawings (requires the Excalidraw plugin)
PDF++ rectangle selections (requires the PDF++ plugin)

summary: Plugin that arranges images, videos, embeds and text into side-by-side layout blocks with drag handles for resizing and reordering.
